content: अतिपातः .²1 Passing away, lapse (of time); अहो काल˚ तः <ls>Māl. 2</ls>. .²2 Neglect, omission; transgression; न चेदन्यकार्यातिपातः <ls>Ś. 1</ls> if no other duty be neglected thereby, if it should not interfere with (the discharge of) any other duty; deviation from established laws or customs. .²3 Befalling, occurrence; दुःखातिपातेन कलुषीक्रियन्ते. <ls>K. 289</ls>; जलधारातिपातः <ls n="K.">302</ls> falling. .²4 Ill-treatment, or usage. .²5 Opposition, contrariety. .²6 Destruction; प्राणातिपातनिरतो निरनुकोशतां गतः <ls>Rām. 1. 59. 21</ls>.
